nasa_power.service: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Daily Point API, AG community

variables.T2M: Daily mean air temperature at 2 m, °C
variables.T2M_MAX: Daily maximum air temperature at 2 m, °C
variables.T2M_MIN: Daily minimum air temperature at 2 m, °C
variables.PRECTOTCORR: Daily corrected precipitation, mm/day (summed over one-day intervals as mm)

nasa_power.limits: Historical gridded weather. The request point identifies the requested location, not a field sensor. The data do not measure field soil moisture or irrigation supply and do not forecast future seasons.

application: HTML, CSS, Fetch, Geolocation and browser print APIs
IBM Plex Sans Arabic via Fontsource 5.2.6, OFL-1.1
development_and_verification: Anthropic Claude for the user-supplied plan and initial rebuild code (model version unverified)
delivery: OpenAI Artifact Tool for editable slides
GitHub and GitHub Pages for the rebuild source and static hosting
ChatGPT Sites for the earlier public build
ReportLab and pypdf for the seven-page slide PDF
OpenAI ImageGen for an archived illustration from an earlier build

materials.demo: Rebuild English presentation with genuine captured application screenshots, source notes and AI disclosure. Earlier delivery files retain historical scope.
materials.current_app: No decorative photographic, video or audio assets. Interactive OpenStreetMap views and app-generated charts appear when requested.

model.optional_context: Priority reorders explanations only. Optional user notes and separately documented soil ECe / irrigation-water ECw appear in review, print and audit; neither EC measurement changes ETc or produces suitability.
model.local_research_comparison: Separate fictional forage case: unknown baseline, sorghum_vetch and sesbania_barley, documented by LENSES D2.2 section 3.1.1. Exact dates and whole-cycle water demand unavailable. Potential soil mechanisms are general, not measured local effects. No vegetable coefficients are transferred.
model.method: FAO-56 Eq. 9, 21–25 and 52 (Hargreaves) and ETc = Kc × ETo
model.crop_profiles: Seven generic FAO-56 Table 11/12 profiles with disclosed stage/parameter choices. Okra and other crops show weather only.
model.uncertainty: Median and min–max of complete shared historical seasons. Explicit Kc ±10% sensitivity. No field calibration.
model.water: Gross mm = m³ per turn / area in metric dunums. An explicit efficiency scenario can adjust it. Effective rain and soil-water storage are excluded.
